reading: This is a Google-Calendar-style week view: a left sidebar (create button, mini month calendar, 'My calendars' list) drawn with s0; a header row of 7 day/date cards (MON 8 – SUN 14) drawn with s1; a left-hand column of hourly time labels (8 AM–9 PM) drawn with s2; a large striped time grid background drawn with s3; 7 solid coloured event blocks positioned on that grid; a thin red current-time indicator line with a dot (s3+s5); and a floating event-detail popup panel for 'Sprint planning' with a Join call button (s3+s6).
